name: Hamper Deal
summary: A bundle builder where treats arc into a wicker hamper and a gift tag flips to the live discount
about: A build-your-own bundle for an Eid gift hamper with six treats and four slots. Each treat you pick arcs off the shelf and lands in the straw with a squash, the basket wiggles and the gift tag on the rim flips to the new discount: 5% for two, 10% for three, 15% for four. Adding the hamper drops a woven lid, wraps a ribbon, pops a bow and throws confetti before the treats fly home for the next one.
how: Tap a treat on the shelf: it flies into the next free slot of the hamper and the straw puffs
Watch the tier bars fill and the tag flip to 5%, 10% or 15% as the hamper fills up
Tap a treat again, on the shelf or in the hamper, to hop it back out
The summary shows the treats total, the discount and the hamper price in PKR as rolling numbers
Press Add hamper to cart: the lid drops, the ribbon wraps, a bow pops and the cart count goes up
